events.title: Dungeons Have Appeared in Andrea
events.summary: The Great Sundering didn't only leave its wounds on the surface. As you travel, you'll start to notice entrances that shouldn't be there — stairways half-buried in rubble, fissures running down into the dark, tunnels no one remembers digging. Go down, and you'll find worse things waiting. You'll also find better ones. events.title: Andrea - Prelude Is Now Live
events.summary: Hi everyone,The demo for ANDREA is now live on Steam. It's free — just hit download.I'm a solo developer, so this is very much a first pass and there will be rough edges. If you run into a bug, something feels off, or you just have thoughts after playing, please let me know in the discussion forums. Every piece of feedback genuinely helps.If you enjoy it, a wishlist would mean a lot. Thank you for taking the time.
